objective: Review the non-executing direct command-path sidecar stage-plan materialization fixture, accept only the adapter-and-plan-resolution bridge metadata, and select a definition-only execution boundary without claiming direct command execution, sidecar stage execution, compare execution, timing, arbitrary filelist support, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI change, or raw full-state equality.

review_decision.reason: The implementation keeps the direct fixture result out of stage-plan authority: it requires the reviewed direct fixture surface, status, and exact keyset; requires all reference-only flags to remain false; revalidates parser_payload through the shared direct parser-payload validator; cross-checks duplicated direct schedule and build-input fields against that revalidated payload; normalizes explicit sidecar context; then routes through the reviewed parser-to-sidecar adapter payload and existing plan-resolution helper before exposing stage-plan metadata.
review_decision.weakest_point: The helper now exposes reviewed sidecar stage-plan metadata, but that metadata is still not command execution authority. The next gate may define an execution boundary, but it must remain definition-only and must require reviewed ready stage-plan metadata, explicit stage ordering, generated evidence boundaries, and coverage-output comparison rules before any command can run.

direct top-level schedule and build-input fields are checked against the revalidated parser payload before plan resolution

all execution, measurement, timing, runtime/ABI, source-closure, filelist-expansion, and automatic-allocation flags remain false
